analysis.narrative:
📊 **Consensus:** Cautiously bearish with medium conviction - structural headwinds and regulatory pressures outweigh forward-looking bullish catalysts in the near term, though AI/robotics sectors show resilience.

📈 **Themes:** (1) AI/robotics momentum creating sector bifurcation - enterprise automation adoption vs broader market policy pressure, (2) Regulatory tightening and security vulnerabilities weighing on crypto and compliance-sensitive sectors, (3) Consumer discretionary demand softening amid policy-induced inflation pressures.

🎯 **Levels:** SPY ($691.66): Call Wall $750 (56k OI, dormant), Put Wall $630 (149k OI, dormant). Max Pain $693. Active near support: $670 (81k OI, 3.1% away). QQQ ($621.26): Call Wall $650 (28k OI, active hedging), Put Wall $574.78 (116k OI, dormant). Max Pain $625. Active near resistance: $630 (27k OI, 1.4% away).
